source.plugin_dependencies: external; source hashes describe current files, not captured runtime state

definitions.repeat_profile: Every scene/run uses a new Chrome profile, but the code has already been compiled on this machine; this is not a pristine machine cold-start test.
definitions.render: 40 synchronous render+1pixel readback samples per view per run; medians across runs and pooled nearest-rank p95 retained.
definitions.RSS: ps Chrome process-tree sum, shared pages may be counted repeatedly; not GPU VRAM or unique resident memory.
definitions.navigation: HTTP server is ready before navigation timing; not whole CLI-to-app latency.
definitions.first_use: Original v3 first-use events remain separate, so faster repeated runs do not conceal them.
